title: Assam Chief Minister's Jan Arogya Yojana (MMJAY/State pathway) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: State-linked health assurance pathway providing government-funded hospitalization support to eligible Assam beneficiaries.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the current Assam beneficiary database and state/PM-JAY implementation rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Assam Chief Minister's Jan Arogya Yojana (MMJAY/State pathway).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
